metadata.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026. Centerline digitization by OpenRacetrackDB.
notes: The northern Track Two follows the long northeastern straight, eastern hairpin, small upper chicane, outer northern loop, inner western U and paved southwestern return. The team identifies Track Two and links a complete February 2026 onboard lap. The operator independently identifies the northern circuit at https://apexmotorclub.com/track/. Coordinates come only from the independently georeferenced 18 September 2026 public Sentinel bands. The 5 June 2026 bands corroborate the western paved U and return diagonal; the separate lower drainage line and southern-course branches are excluded. The previously rejected candidate followed those unrelated branches and is not reused. Native 10 m samples are reprojected with nearest-neighbor resampling and contrast stretched without adding spatial detail. Intermediate straight vertices preserve the same observed corridor. The measured length is not adjusted to an advertised or supplied distance. Fine corner alignment, direction and historical equivalence remain draft; this is a coarse supporting course trace, not a surveyed racing line. No supplied diagram coordinates or private course boundary data are imported. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 4080.7 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Approximate 3D playback follows a boundary-normal midpoint path inside the unchanged supplemental inner and outer borders. The independently georeferenced 18 September 2026 Sentinel image corroborates this configuration at its native 10 m resolution, including the paved combined-course connector for Apex III; it does not verify fine edge positions or road widths. The original source trace, timing and border coordinates remain unchanged. Curbs are illustrative, raster terrain heights are estimated and banking is unknown.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use midpoints of outward inner-boundary normals intersecting the outer boundary; the source trace is preserved, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
